title: How to Finish Stalled MVPs for Founders Using Claude Code #Shorts
description:
Non-technical founders frequently get stuck on login, Stripe webhooks, and deployment.
Using Claude Code, you can audit broken repositories, resolve edge cases, and ship working MVPs for clients.
Manual code testing is required to verify AI output and avoid shipping bugs.

1. Clone the client's broken repo in your terminal and launch Claude Code with 'claude'
2. Run: 'Inspect auth routes, implement Stripe webhook checkout verification, and add passing tests'
3. Review git diff line-by-line, test environment variables locally, and deploy to Vercel

Tool used:
- name: Claude Code CLI
- endpoint: claude 'audit auth/stripe integration, fix missing edge cases, and ensure npm run build succeeds'
- docs: Claude Code CLI Overview

audit-prompt.sh (bash) - Run directly in your terminal inside the root directory of the client repository.:
claude 'audit auth/stripe integration, fix missing edge cases, and ensure npm run build succeeds'

The catch: Claude Code can hallucinate broken dependencies; manual code review and test coverage are non-negotiable.

Sources for the numbers:
- Sabrina Ramonov (sabrina.dev)
- aibusiness.vc

Real ways to earn with AI, no hype - follow @GSXAutomation

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic; Claude is a trademark of Anthropic. Education only - not financial, investment, trading or tax advice. Income numbers are what the named creators reported; results vary and nothing is guaranteed.
